raw_text: AltNews AI Check: The image circulating as a 'leaked photo of India's stealth drone over Ladakh' is a Midjourney AI-generated artwork from a digital art competition. We traced the image to its original creator and contest submission. Key indicators of AI generation include: no EXIF camera metadata, visible AI artifacts in mountain textures, physically impossible shadow angles, and confirmation from the art contest organizers. No Indian defence source has confirmed any stealth drone program matching this design.
clean_text: AltNews confirms viral stealth drone image is Midjourney artwork from art competition. No EXIF data, visible AI artifacts, impossible shadows. No defence source confirms such program.
